data.speaker: Dreamer
data.text:
Oh... someone is here.
I thought I dreamed you, but you're still here when I blink.
I am — I was — I think I am still Isabelle.

choices.text: I'm looking for a Crystal Key.

data.speaker: Dreamer
data.text:
There is something in this room I can't quite reach. A key, I think. Warm like afternoon light.
But I can't... the edges of things keep moving.

data.speaker: Dreamer
data.text:
I dream around things more than through them now.
I used to write everything down — every vision, every fragment.
But my diary is gone and without it I can't find the edges of myself.
I keep feeling like something was written for me, somewhere in this house. A letter, maybe.

data.speaker: Dreamer
data.text:
My diary. I had it once — I wrote everything in it.
I gave it to Professor Starweaver to study, and then...
No, wait. That's not right. I can't remember the order of things.
There was a letter somewhere. I keep feeling the letter.

data.speaker: Dreamer
data.text:
The yellow key. Yes. It's here somewhere — I've dreamed it clearly.
But I can't reach it yet. I need to remember something first.
There was a letter. Somewhere in this house. If I could just see it...

data.speaker: Dreamer
data.text:
A letter. Somewhere in the house — written for me, I think.
I can feel it the way you feel a word you can't quite say.
Find it. Bring it here.

data.speaker: Dreamer
data.text:
A letter. Somewhere in the house.
I can feel it the way you feel a word you can't quite say.
Find it — bring it here.

data.speaker: Dreamer
data.text:
Oh.
*she takes it, very slowly*
Oh, I know this handwriting.
*she reads in silence for a moment*

choices.text: Do you remember where your diary is?

data.speaker: Dreamer
data.text:
I remember now. The diary — I gave it to Professor Starweaver.
He's in the observatory. Upstairs, east corridor.
He'll want something in return. He always does.

data.speaker: Dreamer
data.text:
I'm not sure I should say.
Something I've been holding onto for a very long time.
It doesn't matter now — what matters is the diary.

data.speaker: Dreamer
data.text:
The observatory. Professor Starweaver — upstairs, east corridor.
He'll want his telescope back, and there's something else he lost.
A star chart. He mentioned it was locked in a box downstairs. The combination is somewhere in the garden.

data.speaker: Dreamer
data.text:
The diary is with Professor Starweaver. The observatory — upstairs, east corridor.
He'll want his telescope back, and a star chart he locked away.
The combination for the box is in the garden.

data.speaker: Dreamer
data.text:
My diary.
*she holds it without opening it*
I don't need to read it. I just needed to know it existed.
That I existed. That I wrote things down and they were real.

data.speaker: Dreamer
data.text:
The yellow key — I dreamed someone would come for it. I dreamed you, I think.
Take it to the yellow pedestal in the main hall.
All four together — that's how it ends.

data.speaker: Dreamer
data.text:
Obtained Yellow Crystal Key
You now have {keys_collected|round} of 4 Crystal Keys.

data.speaker: Dreamer
data.text:
I dreamed this moment clearly, for once.
Go. The four pedestals.
I'll still be here dreaming — but perhaps after this, the dreams will finally be peaceful.
